name: Cloudflare
description: Hosts DNS for ironwallengraving.com and points production traffic at the active CloudFront distribution. During DR, Cloudflare is the manual DNS cutover point.

name: Auth0
description: Provides JWT-based admin authentication for protected API Gateway routes and admin access inside the storefront.

name: Stripe
description: Processes checkout payments, calculates tax, and sends payment/dispute webhooks back to the production API.

name: Shippo
description: Provides shipping rates, label purchase, and shipment tracking webhook support for checkout and fulfillment.
